newsitem.title: UK: UK recycling Services Group to float on AIM.
newsitem.headline: UK recycling Services Group to float on AIM.

text.p: Recycling Services Group Plc, the metals recycling group, said on Wednesday it is planning to float on the Alternative Investment Market (AIM) via a placing valuing the company at 14.0 million stg.
The float, sponsored by stockbroker Albert E Sharp, will raise 4.0 million stg which will be used to part-fund the acquisition of G&P Batteries Ltd, a battery collector and recycler.
The acquisition will enable the group to expand into lead recycling, chief executive Roy Pendleton told Reuters.
The group's two existing subsidiaries, JBR Recovery Ltd and Aston Recoup, recycle silver from photographic and chemical waste and copper, aluminium, rubber and PVC from electronic waste and cables.
"All our companies are profitable and we've got a well established track record," said Pendleton.
Dealing in the shares is expected to commence in late November.
